'''Crapo:''' {{legend0|#ffb2b2|40–50%}} {{legend0|#e27f7f|50–60%}} {{legend0|#d75d5d|60–70%}} {{legend0|#d72f30|70–80%}} {{legend0|#c21b18|80–90%}} {{legend0|#a80000|>90%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Dirk Kempthorne]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Mike Crapo]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsID}} The '''1998 United States Senate election in Idaho''' was held November 3, 1998 alongside [[1998 United States Senate elections|other]] elections to the [[United States Senate]] in other states as well as [[1998 United States House of Representatives elections|elections]] to the [[United States House of Representatives]] and various state and local elections. Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] U.S. Senator [[Dirk Kempthorne]] decided to retire after one term to run for [[1998 Idaho gubernatorial election|governor]].
